_doc: A worked example on a stock hero: copy it into your mod (for example <mod>/source/qa/heroes/<hero>.json), name your own meshes and materials, and run run_qa.py --hero <that file>. Valve's own names are from build 6865.

classes._doc: how a compiled component is classed: by render mesh name (the part after 'haze.'), else by its majority material, else default. skin/gear are Valve's body and kit; outfit/cloth are a mod's own; fx is never collision-tested

families._doc: regex on a piece label -> the family a finding is filed under when both sides belong to it, or the first side's family
